R15 an effort is a lowercase word of at most 16 letters, or null where none was stated: any other value is refused AI_RUN_CONSUME_INVALID counting nothing, on countUsage and countAskUsage alike (negative control: 'Low!', 'MEDIUM', a seventeen-letter word, a number)
R15 an entry stating neither model nor effort is kept as {model: null, effort: null}, never a guessed one; a stated effort without a model is kept with model null
R15 the counter ai_usage keeps no model or effort key: the models of a conversation are kept beside its act only

R15 two conversations under one act answer two by_model entries, first seen first, their calls summed per model and effort (claude-sonnet-5-5 low twice, claude-opus-5-5 medium once: 2 and 1 calls); the act's calls are their sum
R16 ai-use declares ailimitset: its requires alone raise no refusal naming a field, each missing one is refused naming it, and a field outside accepts is dropped or refused
R16 ai-use declares exploreapprove: its requires alone raise no refusal naming a field, each missing one is refused naming it, and a field outside accepts is dropped or refused
R17 a handed now answers first, before the store's BIO_NOW_MS; the day it judges and the instant it records are that clock's
R17 an instant an op records under a pinned BIO_NOW_MS reads that clock; with none, the wall clock
R17 with the environment only (no handed now), a judgement and an instant read BIO_NOW_MS
R2 (T42) a store whose carry already ran but which still holds ai_ceilings drops it at its next migration, carrying nothing again; idempotent
R2 (T42) once carried, ai_ceilings is dropped in the same migration, so a migrated store holds no table a fresh one lacks; a table it does not own is kept (control)
R2 (T43, Terms) a use is an ai-accounts.USE_KINDS entry, its R14's nine: each is counted and each is a limit's scope; anything else is refused (negative control)
R2 aiLimitSet holds at most one limit per owner, scope, unit and period: set, changed, removed (amount null), each appended to the history with who and when

R2 scope is overall, a USE_KINDS entry, or per_member for a group or project account; unit usd, tokens or calls; period day or month; amount positive (usd to the cent, the others whole) or null; inclusive only for a use scope; anything else AI_LIMIT_INVALID naming the field, writing nothing

R2 the migration writes today's ceilings: a member's own daily ceiling becomes that member's account's overall day limits in tokens and calls; the copy-wide ceiling the group account's per_member day limits; once
R2 usd on a sign-in is refused LIMIT_UNIT_UNAVAILABLE (a member's sign-in, a project's sign-in account), writing nothing; on an API key it is set, and tokens or calls on a sign-in are set
R2 who may set it is the owner's own act: the member alone (NOT_YOUR_CEILING), a project's owner (ai-accounts' R10 refusals), an active administrator (NOT_AN_ADMIN); each refusal writes nothing
R3 (T42) held is read, never uses alone: an account not held, unreadable, holding another value, or whose read throws, reads as no (EXPLORE_NOT_ENABLED); held at yes it passes (control)
R3 (T42) on the real ai-accounts: the group's explore set while its key is not held reads as no; a revoked member's account reads as no; held, each passes (control)
R3 (T42) the owner's explore is read through ai-accounts.accountUsesOf with no viewer, never through accountUses asked as an owner, on every kind of account

R3 (T43) a limit that cannot be judged (the counter unreadable, the use not a USE_KINDS entry, no paying account) is AI_LIMIT_REACHED with unjudged: true and no scope, unit or period, read as ai.refused.limit.unjudged with {whose} only; a reached one keeps scope, unit and period (negative control)
R3 a month's limit resets on the 1st of the group's local month; a day's at local midnight
R3 exclusive: an exclusive use is refused only at its own limit, and the overall limit is judged without it (a separate allowance on top)

R3 for explore: EXPLORE_NOT_ENABLED when the owner's explore is no; at yes with no explore limit held it is judged against the overall limit alone (control: under it, it passes); ask is not R3's refusal
R3 inclusive (the default): a use counts toward its own limit and the overall one, refused at either; the overall limit is judged over the uses that are not exclusive
R3 it judges only the paying account's limits (D38): the group's limits never bind a member's own account, nor a member's own the group's
R3 it writes nothing and never throws; a counter that cannot be read answers the refusal (fail closed)
R3 per_member: a group or project account's per-member limit is counted over that member's use of that account alone (words ai.refused.limit.member)
R3 useCheck answers null under every limit, and AI_LIMIT_REACHED once the use's own limit is reached for the current period (its words ai.refused.limit, {whose} filled, never a cost)
R4 aiUsage answers an account's owners its month of use per kind of use, summed over members and naming none; anyone else is refused as R2 refuses; it writes nothing
R4 aiUsageMine answers a member their own use per payer and per use, with each limit that bound them; a cost only for the accounts they own; never another member's spending
R4 the ops: aiusage with owner is R4's account read, without it the viewer's own; ailimitset and ailimits take who from the control plane's stamp, never the body
R5 a limit set below what is already used is reached when set; the group's limits are answered to its administrators

R5 limitsReached answers, for each account the viewer owns, each limit first reached in its current period with a stable key; not before it is reached, not to anyone else, not in the next period; it writes nothing

R6 (T48) the keep-away is read from ai-accounts: when its aiKeptAway or projectsKeptAway throws, exploreAllowed answers KEPT_AWAY_UNREADABLE as given, never passing; read as usual, it passes (control)
R6 ai-accounts.aiKeptAway({use: explore}) refuses: the group's keep-away on explore, and a project's own on explore for the project's account; one not covering explore does not (control)
R6 at ask, it answers {ask: true} until the owner approves that local day (R9), then passes; another day asks again
R6 exploreAllowed refuses EXPLORE_NOT_ENABLED when the owner's explore is no (the default), on every kind of account; at yes it passes with the machine's label naming the owner
R6 for the group, a question every project it is drawn on keeps from explore (projectsKeptAway) is refused; drawn on by one that does not, it passes (control)
R6 it writes nothing and never throws
R6 R3's AI_LIMIT_REACHED, by its overall limit and by its explore limit; under them it passes (control)
R6 the question outside the owner's scope is refused EXPLORE_OUT_OF_SCOPE: the group's is every question the record holds, a project's those it draws on (citesInto), a member's none (D36)
R7 a project's limits are deleted with its project, and nothing else is: another account's limits and the counter stay

tests: R1 countUsage adds to the counter kept per owner, member, local day and use: the token sums, the calls and estimated_cost_usd; a second count on the same key adds to it, another key is its own row
R1 a null calls is counted as one, never none; a stated calls as given (negative control: calls 3 counts 3)
R1 the cost summed is the figure usage carries: estimated_cost_usd when stated, else total_cost_usd, else unstated (counted as unstated, never as 0)
R1 the local day is the group's (civil-time.localDay in its zone): 03:00Z in Los Angeles is the day before
R1 a malformed entry is refused AI_RUN_CONSUME_INVALID with run-rules' row, counting nothing; a well-formed one counts (negative control)

R1 countAskUsage counts an ask or a draft, its use its mode, to the owner the caller's accountFor answered; without an owner, as not recorded; any other mode refused AI_RUN_CONSUME_INVALID counting nothing
R1 it never reads a price table: a null figure on usage counts as unstated and adds nothing, whatever the model
R1 the counter holds no content, question or address: its columns are the owner, the member, the day, the use, the mode and numbers
R1 rows from before T40 are kept with owner not recorded, their use read from their mode, and count toward no limit
R1 with an act, its sums are also measured per act (for R10, R11); without one, no act is measured

R7 the tables (ai_usage, ai_limits and their history, with the act measure, the reached limits, the asks and the migrations) are declared through record-core.declareTable: export admin-only, sight group, purged with the whole store

R1 the cost summed is the figure usage carries: estimated_cost_usd when stated, else total_cost_usd, else unstated (counted as unstated, never as 0)
R1 the local day is the group's (civil-time.localDay in its zone): 03:00Z in Los Angeles is the day before
R1 a malformed entry is refused AI_RUN_CONSUME_INVALID with run-rules' row, counting nothing; a well-formed one counts (negative control)

R1 countAskUsage counts an ask or a draft, its use its mode, to the owner the caller's accountFor answered; without an owner, as not recorded; any other mode refused AI_RUN_CONSUME_INVALID counting nothing
R1 it never reads a price table: a null figure on usage counts as unstated and adds nothing, whatever the model
R1 the counter holds no content, question or address: its columns are the owner, the member, the day, the use, the mode and numbers
R1 rows from before T40 are kept with owner not recorded, their use read from their mode, and count toward no limit
R1 with an act, its sums are also measured per act (for R10, R11); without one, no act is measured

R7 the tables (ai_usage, ai_limits and their history, with the act measure, the reached limits, the asks and the migrations) are declared through record-core.declareTable: export admin-only, sight group, purged with the whole store
R7 a project's limits are deleted with its project, and nothing else is: another account's limits and the counter stay
R8 each code this module mints has its row in its own checks.mjs, family C-143 (K2480), numbered once, never a retired run-rules number; its translation the words.json sentence R13 names
R8 AI_LIMIT_REACHED carries whose (group, project or own), scope and period; each refusal carries its row's check
R16 ai-use declares ailimitset: its requires alone raise no refusal naming a field, each missing one is refused naming it, and a field outside accepts is dropped or refused
R16 ai-use declares exploreapprove: its requires alone raise no refusal naming a field, each missing one is refused naming it, and a field outside accepts is dropped or refused
R6 exploreAllowed refuses EXPLORE_NOT_ENABLED when the owner's explore is no (the default), on every kind of account; at yes it passes with the machine's label naming the owner
R6 at ask, it answers {ask: true} until the owner approves that local day (R9), then passes; another day asks again
R6 R3's AI_LIMIT_REACHED, by its overall limit and by its explore limit; under them it passes (control)
R6 ai-accounts.aiKeptAway({use: explore}) refuses: the group's keep-away on explore, and a project's own on explore for the project's account; one not covering explore does not (control)
R6 the question outside the owner's scope is refused EXPLORE_OUT_OF_SCOPE: the group's is every question the record holds, a project's those it draws on (citesInto), a member's none (D36)
R6 for the group, a question every project it is drawn on keeps from explore (projectsKeptAway) is refused; drawn on by one that does not, it passes (control)
R6 it writes nothing and never throws

R9 exploreAsk records at most one pending ask an owner and local day, for an owner whose explore is ask; a second ask that day answers the first's key and mints nothing; at no or yes it is refused EXPLORE_NOT_ENABLED

R9 exploreAsksPending answers today's unapproved asks to the account's owners only, each stating the questions and R10's rough cost, its words ai.queue.exploreask; it writes nothing and never throws; approved, an ask is no longer pending
R9 exploreApprove is one of the account's owners' act, refused as R2's for anyone else, writing nothing; a malformed day is refused; silence means no
R10 estimate answers "not known yet" until 5 acts of that use and mode are measured, then the least and greatest per-act figure over the latest 20, times count: usd when every act stated a cost
R10 on a subscription (no cost stated) the range is in tokens and calls; it is answered only to the account's owners
R11 actualOf answers a run's or an act's actual cost after, in R10's units, only to the paying account's owners; to anyone else, and for an act not measured, found false

fixtures ceilingRefusal R3 R13: the real useCheck over a spent daily ceiling is AI_LIMIT_REACHED (check C-143.1) with the use's sentence filled, naming the project and no cost; the next local day it is null
fixtures-contract use-check R3: while a member's transcribe limit is spent, the real useCheck answers the refusal the contract states, and null before the spend
R2 aiLimitSet holds at most one limit per owner, scope, unit and period: set, changed, removed (amount null), each appended to the history with who and when

R2 scope is overall, a USE_KINDS entry, or per_member for a group or project account; unit usd, tokens or calls; period day or month; amount positive (usd to the cent, the others whole) or null; inclusive only for a use scope; anything else AI_LIMIT_INVALID naming the field, writing nothing
R2 who may set it is the owner's own act: the member alone (NOT_YOUR_CEILING), a project's owner (ai-accounts' R10 refusals), an active administrator (NOT_AN_ADMIN); each refusal writes nothing
R2 usd on a sign-in is refused LIMIT_UNIT_UNAVAILABLE (a member's sign-in, a project's sign-in account), writing nothing; on an API key it is set, and tokens or calls on a sign-in are set

R2 the migration writes today's ceilings: a member's own daily ceiling becomes that member's account's overall day limits in tokens and calls; the copy-wide ceiling the group account's per_member day limits; once
R3 useCheck answers null under every limit, and AI_LIMIT_REACHED once the use's own limit is reached for the current period (its words ai.refused.limit, {whose} filled, never a cost)
R3 inclusive (the default): a use counts toward its own limit and the overall one, refused at either; the overall limit is judged over the uses that are not exclusive
R3 exclusive: an exclusive use is refused only at its own limit, and the overall limit is judged without it (a separate allowance on top)
R3 per_member: a group or project account's per-member limit is counted over that member's use of that account alone (words ai.refused.limit.member)
R3 it judges only the paying account's limits (D38): the group's limits never bind a member's own account, nor a member's own the group's
R3 a month's limit resets on the 1st of the group's local month; a day's at local midnight

R3 for explore: EXPLORE_NOT_ENABLED when the owner's explore is no; at yes with no explore limit held it is judged against the overall limit alone (control: under it, it passes); ask is not R3's refusal
R3 it writes nothing and never throws; a counter that cannot be read answers the refusal (fail closed)
R17 an instant an op records under a pinned BIO_NOW_MS reads that clock; with none, the wall clock
R17 a handed now answers first, before the store's BIO_NOW_MS; the day it judges and the instant it records are that clock's
R17 with the environment only (no handed now), a judgement and an instant read BIO_NOW_MS
R4 aiUsage answers an account's owners its month of use per kind of use, summed over members and naming none; anyone else is refused as R2 refuses; it writes nothing
R4 aiUsageMine answers a member their own use per payer and per use, with each limit that bound them; a cost only for the accounts they own; never another member's spending
R4 the ops: aiusage with owner is R4's account read, without it the viewer's own; ailimitset and ailimits take who from the control plane's stamp, never the body

R5 limitsReached answers, for each account the viewer owns, each limit first reached in its current period with a stable key; not before it is reached, not to anyone else, not in the next period; it writes nothing
R5 a limit set below what is already used is reached when set; the group's limits are answered to its administrators

R12 aiLimits answers each limit of one account (scope, use, unit, period, inclusive or on top) with its use in the current period naming no member, and its history (set, changed, removed; who and when), to its owners only
R12 anyone but the account's owners is refused as ai-accounts R15 refuses them, writing nothing

R13 each refusal's member-facing sentence is read by key from words.json, verbatim: AI_LIMIT_REACHED by its scope with {whose} filled from ai.whose.*, never a cost; AI_LIMIT_INVALID, LIMIT_UNIT_UNAVAILABLE, EXPLORE_NOT_ENABLED; the Ask item ai.queue.exploreask

R13 (K2514) every refusal's sentence reaches its caller whole, no placeholder left: AI_LIMIT_REACHED for every owner, scope and period with {whose}, {use}, {period} and {when} filled (daily: tomorrow; monthly: the 1st of the next month, December's in January), also when R3 fails closed; AI_LIMIT_INVALID with {field} filled for every field
R2 (T42) once carried, ai_ceilings is dropped in the same migration, so a migrated store holds no table a fresh one lacks; a table it does not own is kept (control)
R2 (T42) a store whose carry already ran but which still holds ai_ceilings drops it at its next migration, carrying nothing again; idempotent
R3 (T42) the owner's explore is read through ai-accounts.accountUsesOf with no viewer, never through accountUses asked as an owner, on every kind of account
R3 (T42) held is read, never uses alone: an account not held, unreadable, holding another value, or whose read throws, reads as no (EXPLORE_NOT_ENABLED); held at yes it passes (control)
R3 (T42) on the real ai-accounts: the group's explore set while its key is not held reads as no; a revoked member's account reads as no; held, each passes (control)
R13 (T43) every AI_USE_WORDS entry equals its words.json en verbatim, ai.refused.explorenotenabled included; a changed character fails (negative control)

R3 (T43) a limit that cannot be judged (the counter unreadable, the use not a USE_KINDS entry, no paying account) is AI_LIMIT_REACHED with unjudged: true and no scope, unit or period, read as ai.refused.limit.unjudged with {whose} only; a reached one keeps scope, unit and period (negative control)

R13 (T43) every fill is read by key: {use} from ai.use.<use>.inline (transcribe's included), {period} from ai.period.*, {when} from ai.when.day or ai.when.month with the next month from date.month.* for every month; a different period reads a different fill (negative control)
R13 (T43) {field} is read from ai.limitfield.<field> for every field AI_LIMIT_INVALID names; another field reads another key (negative control)
R2 (T43, Terms) a use is an ai-accounts.USE_KINDS entry, its R14's nine: each is counted and each is a limit's scope; anything else is refused (negative control)

R13 (T44) AI_USE_WORDS equals words.json for every key it reads: the exploring refusals, all nine uses' .name and .inline, ai.when.month as "on {month} 1"; a changed or missing key fails (negative control)

R8 (T44) EXPLORE_OUT_OF_SCOPE (C-143.5) and EXPLORE_ASK_INVALID (C-143.6) have their rows, each where naming its site and its translation read by key, neither keeping a sentence of its own; the other rows unchanged (control)
R8 R13 (T44) EXPLORE_OUT_OF_SCOPE carries whose (group, project or own), its sentence ai.refused.exploreoutofscope with {whose} filled from ai.whose.*; an in-scope question passes (negative control)

R8 R13 (T44) EXPLORE_ASK_INVALID answers ai.refused.exploreaskinvalid verbatim, for an ask naming nothing worth exploring and an approval naming no day; a well-formed ask and approval pass (negative control)

R13 (T44) {use} reads ai.use.<use>.inline for all nine uses (enquire, read and account among them): a limit on any use reads ai.refused.limit with its own words; overall and per_member keep their own keys (negative control)
R13 (T44) {Use} at a sentence's start reads ai.use.<use>.name and {use} inside it .inline, for all nine uses; a placeholder not given is left for the screen (negative control)
R13 (T44) a month's {when} is ai.when.month ("on {month} 1") with the next month from date.month.*, for every month; a day's limit reads ai.when.day (negative control)
R9 R13 (T44) the Ask item's {what} is the owner's words exactly as written, a $ in them never read as a replacement pattern; plain words fill the same (negative control)
R13 (T44; N871) LIMIT_PERIOD_FILL, LIMIT_WHEN_FILL and MONTH_NAMES are gone from checks.mjs and index.mjs; the keys they copied are still provided (negative control)
R14 two members' uses on three days are answered as day totals of calls and dollars, naming neither member
R14 days are the thirty local days ending with the day of at, oldest first; a day with no use is answered with zeros; a use outside them is not answered
R14 the days of a month sum to that month's total as R4's aiUsage answers it, in calls and dollars
R14 a day limit and a month limit are each answered with the use counted against it in its current period up to at, and the limit in its unit
R14 a per_member limit's used is the most any one member used, naming none; an overall limit counts the uses that are not exclusive, as R3 judges them
R14 with no limit set, periods is one entry for the month with limit null, its use the month's dollars to the day of at; a limit set replaces it (control)
R14 anyone but the account's owners is refused as R12 refuses them (ai-accounts R15's refusals), writing nothing; each owner reads it (control)
R14 the op aiuseovertime answers the account named, its viewer the control plane's stamp, never the body's
R14 it writes nothing and never throws; control: the counter made unreadable answers unreadable: true, never zeros

R1 it never reads a price table: a null figure on usage counts as unstated and adds nothing, whatever the model
R1 the counter holds no content, question or address: its columns are the owner, the member, the day, the use, the mode and numbers
R1 rows from before T40 are kept with owner not recorded, their use read from their mode, and count toward no limit

R7 the tables (ai_usage, ai_limits and their history, with the act measure, the reached limits, the asks and the migrations) are declared through record-core.declareTable: export admin-only, sight group, purged with the whole store
R7 a project's limits are deleted with its project, and nothing else is: another account's limits and the counter stay
R8 each code this module mints has its row in its own checks.mjs, family C-143 (K2480), numbered once, never a retired run-rules number; its translation the words.json sentence R13 names
R8 AI_LIMIT_REACHED carries whose (group, project or own), scope and period; each refusal carries its row's check
R16 ai-use declares ailimitset: its requires alone raise no refusal naming a field, each missing one is refused naming it, and a field outside accepts is dropped or refused
R16 ai-use declares exploreapprove: its requires alone raise no refusal naming a field, each missing one is refused naming it, and a field outside accepts is dropped or refused
R6 exploreAllowed refuses EXPLORE_NOT_ENABLED when the owner's explore is no (the default), on every kind of account; at yes it passes with the machine's label naming the owner
R6 at ask, it answers {ask: true} until the owner approves that local day (R9), then passes; another day asks again
R6 R3's AI_LIMIT_REACHED, by its overall limit and by its explore limit; under them it passes (control)
R6 ai-accounts.aiKeptAway({use: explore}) refuses: the group's keep-away on explore, and a project's own on explore for the project's account; one not covering explore does not (control)
R6 the question outside the owner's scope is refused EXPLORE_OUT_OF_SCOPE: the group's is every question the record holds, a project's those it draws on (citesInto), a member's none (D36)
R6 for the group, a question every project it is drawn on keeps from explore (projectsKeptAway) is refused; drawn on by one that does not, it passes (control)
R6 it writes nothing and never throws

R9 exploreAsk records at most one pending ask an owner and local day, for an owner whose explore is ask; a second ask that day answers the first's key and mints nothing; at no or yes it is refused EXPLORE_NOT_ENABLED

R9 exploreAsksPending answers today's unapproved asks to the account's owners only, each stating the questions and R10's rough cost, its words ai.queue.exploreask; it writes nothing and never throws; approved, an ask is no longer pending
R9 exploreApprove is one of the account's owners' act, refused as R2's for anyone else, writing nothing; a malformed day is refused; silence means no
R10 estimate answers "not known yet" until 5 acts of that use and mode are measured, then the least and greatest per-act figure over the latest 20, times count: usd when every act stated a cost
R10 on a subscription (no cost stated) the range is in tokens and calls; it is answered only to the account's owners
R11 actualOf answers a run's or an act's actual cost after, in R10's units, only to the paying account's owners; to anyone else, and for an act not measured, found false

fixtures ceilingRefusal R3 R13: the real useCheck over a spent daily ceiling is AI_LIMIT_REACHED (check C-143.1) with the use's sentence filled, naming the project and no cost; the next local day it is null
fixtures-contract use-check R3: while a member's transcribe limit is spent, the real useCheck answers the refusal the contract states, and null before the spend
R2 aiLimitSet holds at most one limit per owner, scope, unit and period: set, changed, removed (amount null), each appended to the history with who and when

R2 scope is overall, a USE_KINDS entry, or per_member for a group or project account; unit usd, tokens or calls; period day or month; amount positive (usd to the cent, the others whole) or null; inclusive only for a use scope; anything else AI_LIMIT_INVALID naming the field, writing nothing
R2 who may set it is the owner's own act: the member alone (NOT_YOUR_CEILING), a project's owner (ai-accounts' R10 refusals), an active administrator (NOT_AN_ADMIN); each refusal writes nothing
R2 usd on a sign-in is refused LIMIT_UNIT_UNAVAILABLE (a member's sign-in, a project's sign-in account), writing nothing; on an API key it is set, and tokens or calls on a sign-in are set

R2 the migration writes today's ceilings: a member's own daily ceiling becomes that member's account's overall day limits in tokens and calls; the copy-wide ceiling the group account's per_member day limits; once
R3 useCheck answers null under every limit, and AI_LIMIT_REACHED once the use's own limit is reached for the current period (its words ai.refused.limit, {whose} filled, never a cost)
R3 inclusive (the default): a use counts toward its own limit and the overall one, refused at either; the overall limit is judged over the uses that are not exclusive
R3 exclusive: an exclusive use is refused only at its own limit, and the overall limit is judged without it (a separate allowance on top)
R3 per_member: a group or project account's per-member limit is counted over that member's use of that account alone (words ai.refused.limit.member)
R3 it judges only the paying account's limits (D38): the group's limits never bind a member's own account, nor a member's own the group's
R3 a month's limit resets on the 1st of the group's local month; a day's at local midnight

R3 for explore: EXPLORE_NOT_ENABLED when the owner's explore is no; at yes with no explore limit held it is judged against the overall limit alone (control: under it, it passes); ask is not R3's refusal
R3 it writes nothing and never throws; a counter that cannot be read answers the refusal (fail closed)
R17 an instant an op records under a pinned BIO_NOW_MS reads that clock; with none, the wall clock
R17 a handed now answers first, before the store's BIO_NOW_MS; the day it judges and the instant it records are that clock's
R17 with the environment only (no handed now), a judgement and an instant read BIO_NOW_MS
R4 aiUsage answers an account's owners its month of use per kind of use, summed over members and naming none; anyone else is refused as R2 refuses; it writes nothing
R4 aiUsageMine answers a member their own use per payer and per use, with each limit that bound them; a cost only for the accounts they own; never another member's spending
R4 the ops: aiusage with owner is R4's account read, without it the viewer's own; ailimitset and ailimits take who from the control plane's stamp, never the body

R5 limitsReached answers, for each account the viewer owns, each limit first reached in its current period with a stable key; not before it is reached, not to anyone else, not in the next period; it writes nothing
R5 a limit set below what is already used is reached when set; the group's limits are answered to its administrators

R12 aiLimits answers each limit of one account (scope, use, unit, period, inclusive or on top) with its use in the current period naming no member, and its history (set, changed, removed; who and when), to its owners only
R12 anyone but the account's owners is refused as ai-accounts R15 refuses them, writing nothing

R13 each refusal's member-facing sentence is read by key from words.json, verbatim: AI_LIMIT_REACHED by its scope with {whose} filled from ai.whose.*, never a cost; AI_LIMIT_INVALID, LIMIT_UNIT_UNAVAILABLE, EXPLORE_NOT_ENABLED; the Ask item ai.queue.exploreask

R13 (K2514) every refusal's sentence reaches its caller whole, no placeholder left: AI_LIMIT_REACHED for every owner, scope and period with {whose}, {use}, {period} and {when} filled (daily: tomorrow; monthly: the 1st of the next month, December's in January), also when R3 fails closed; AI_LIMIT_INVALID with {field} filled for every field
R2 (T42) once carried, ai_ceilings is dropped in the same migration, so a migrated store holds no table a fresh one lacks; a table it does not own is kept (control)
R2 (T42) a store whose carry already ran but which still holds ai_ceilings drops it at its next migration, carrying nothing again; idempotent
R3 (T42) the owner's explore is read through ai-accounts.accountUsesOf with no viewer, never through accountUses asked as an owner, on every kind of account
R3 (T42) held is read, never uses alone: an account not held, unreadable, holding another value, or whose read throws, reads as no (EXPLORE_NOT_ENABLED); held at yes it passes (control)
R3 (T42) on the real ai-accounts: the group's explore set while its key is not held reads as no; a revoked member's account reads as no; held, each passes (control)
R13 (T43) every AI_USE_WORDS entry equals its words.json en verbatim, ai.refused.explorenotenabled included; a changed character fails (negative control)

R3 (T43) a limit that cannot be judged (the counter unreadable, the use not a USE_KINDS entry, no paying account) is AI_LIMIT_REACHED with unjudged: true and no scope, unit or period, read as ai.refused.limit.unjudged with {whose} only; a reached one keeps scope, unit and period (negative control)

R13 (T43) every fill is read by key: {use} from ai.use.<use>.inline (transcribe's included), {period} from ai.period.*, {when} from ai.when.day or ai.when.month with the next month from date.month.* for every month; a different period reads a different fill (negative control)
R13 (T43) {field} is read from ai.limitfield.<field> for every field AI_LIMIT_INVALID names; another field reads another key (negative control)
R2 (T43, Terms) a use is an ai-accounts.USE_KINDS entry, its R14's nine: each is counted and each is a limit's scope; anything else is refused (negative control)

R13 (T44) AI_USE_WORDS equals words.json for every key it reads: the exploring refusals, all nine uses' .name and .inline, ai.when.month as "on {month} 1"; a changed or missing key fails (negative control)

R8 (T44) EXPLORE_OUT_OF_SCOPE (C-143.5) and EXPLORE_ASK_INVALID (C-143.6) have their rows, each where naming its site and its translation read by key, neither keeping a sentence of its own; the other rows unchanged (control)
R8 R13 (T44) EXPLORE_OUT_OF_SCOPE carries whose (group, project or own), its sentence ai.refused.exploreoutofscope with {whose} filled from ai.whose.*; an in-scope question passes (negative control)

R8 R13 (T44) EXPLORE_ASK_INVALID answers ai.refused.exploreaskinvalid verbatim, for an ask naming nothing worth exploring and an approval naming no day; a well-formed ask and approval pass (negative control)

R13 (T44) {use} reads ai.use.<use>.inline for all nine uses (enquire, read and account among them): a limit on any use reads ai.refused.limit with its own words; overall and per_member keep their own keys (negative control)
R13 (T44) {Use} at a sentence's start reads ai.use.<use>.name and {use} inside it .inline, for all nine uses; a placeholder not given is left for the screen (negative control)
R13 (T44) a month's {when} is ai.when.month ("on {month} 1") with the next month from date.month.*, for every month; a day's limit reads ai.when.day (negative control)
R9 R13 (T44) the Ask item's {what} is the owner's words exactly as written, a $ in them never read as a replacement pattern; plain words fill the same (negative control)
R13 (T44; N871) LIMIT_PERIOD_FILL, LIMIT_WHEN_FILL and MONTH_NAMES are gone from checks.mjs and index.mjs; the keys they copied are still provided (negative control)
R14 two members' uses on three days are answered as day totals of calls and dollars, naming neither member
R14 days are the thirty local days ending with the day of at, oldest first; a day with no use is answered with zeros; a use outside them is not answered
R14 the days of a month sum to that month's total as R4's aiUsage answers it, in calls and dollars
R14 a day limit and a month limit are each answered with the use counted against it in its current period up to at, and the limit in its unit
R14 a per_member limit's used is the most any one member used, naming none; an overall limit counts the uses that are not exclusive, as R3 judges them
R14 with no limit set, periods is one entry for the month with limit null, its use the month's dollars to the day of at; a limit set replaces it (control)
R14 anyone but the account's owners is refused as R12 refuses them (ai-accounts R15's refusals), writing nothing; each owner reads it (control)
R14 the op aiuseovertime answers the account named, its viewer the control plane's stamp, never the body's
R14 it writes nothing and never throws; control: the counter made unreadable answers unreadable: true, never zeros

R15 a count without an act keeps no model or effort measure: the act table holds only acts' own rows (negative control)

R2 who may set it is the owner's own act: the member alone (NOT_YOUR_CEILING), a project's owner (ai-accounts' R10 refusals), an active administrator (NOT_AN_ADMIN); each refusal writes nothing
R2 usd on a sign-in is refused LIMIT_UNIT_UNAVAILABLE (a member's sign-in, a project's sign-in account), writing nothing; on an API key it is set, and tokens or calls on a sign-in are set

R2 the migration writes today's ceilings: a member's own daily ceiling becomes that member's account's overall day limits in tokens and calls; the copy-wide ceiling the group account's per_member day limits; once
R3 useCheck answers null under every limit, and AI_LIMIT_REACHED once the use's own limit is reached for the current period (its words ai.refused.limit, {whose} filled, never a cost)
R3 inclusive (the default): a use counts toward its own limit and the overall one, refused at either; the overall limit is judged over the uses that are not exclusive
R3 exclusive: an exclusive use is refused only at its own limit, and the overall limit is judged without it (a separate allowance on top)
R3 per_member: a group or project account's per-member limit is counted over that member's use of that account alone (words ai.refused.limit.member)
R3 it judges only the paying account's limits (D38): the group's limits never bind a member's own account, nor a member's own the group's
R3 a month's limit resets on the 1st of the group's local month; a day's at local midnight

R3 for explore: EXPLORE_NOT_ENABLED when the owner's explore is no; at yes with no explore limit held it is judged against the overall limit alone (control: under it, it passes); ask is not R3's refusal
R3 it writes nothing and never throws; a counter that cannot be read answers the refusal (fail closed)
